case_studies.description: Unified land registry, GIS mapping, and cadastral survey platform automating title verification from 5 days to 14 seconds.
case_studies.challenge: Land title searches in Northern India were bottlenecked across fragmented legacy state registries, taking 3–5 days per parcel with high human error and transaction delays.
case_studies.architecture: Engineered high-throughput Node.js microservices with distributed OCR document indexing, GIS boundary polygon rendering, and automated WhatsApp alert triggers.
case_studies.impact: Reduced title verification time from 5 days to 14 seconds (99.7% speedup); processed 50,000+ title searches with 0% data loss; lifted transaction throughput by 4.2x.

case_studies.description: On-demand workspace booking, automated QR turnstile access, and instant vendor payout reconciliation.
case_studies.challenge: Distributed workforces faced manual desk allocation, spreadsheet invoicing, and lack of real-time seat telemetry across co-working properties.
case_studies.architecture: Built 60fps cross-platform Flutter mobile apps (iOS & Android) and Next.js admin portal with Supabase real-time locks, Stripe/Razorpay webhooks, and QR access tokens.
case_studies.impact: 24,000+ booked desk hours within 90 days; 99.98% booking system uptime; vendor payout reconciliation automated from 4 days to instant ledger settlement.

case_studies.description: Enterprise B2B wholesale ordering platform with real-time batch telemetry and automated Form 20/21 compliance.
case_studies.challenge: Independent pharmacies and regional stockists suffered stockouts and compliance penalties from pen-and-paper ordering and unmonitored drug expiration dates.
case_studies.architecture: Deployed a zero-latency B2B ordering and warehouse orchestration engine with batch-expiry telemetry, automated drug license verification, and multi-depot inventory sync.
case_studies.impact: Order dispatch cycle accelerated by 62%; eliminated batch-expiry inventory wastage by 91%; wholesale distribution volume scaled 3.4x without added overhead.

case_studies.description: Multi-tenant CRM & ERP platform synchronizing dealership inquiries, multi-campus admissions, and GST billing.
case_studies.challenge: Managing multiple automotive dealerships and educational institutions with siloed spreadsheet systems caused lost leads, delayed invoicing, and slow admissions follow-up.
case_studies.architecture: Architected a unified multi-tenant Enterprise ERP and CRM with role-based access control (RBAC), automated lead scoring algorithms, and instant WhatsApp customer alerts.
case_studies.impact: 100% digital adoption across 8 regional branches; 68% reduction in manual data entry hours; lead-to-conversion turnaround improved by 3.8x in quarter one.
